tool_executions.arguments:
{"content":"name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  lint:
    # A pull request from a branch of this repository was already checked on push;
    # pull_request runs are for pull requests from forks.
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: gofmt
        run: |
          unformatted=$(gofmt -l .)
          if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then
            echo "::error::Not gofmt-ed: $unformatted"
            gofmt -d .
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: go vet
        run: go vet ./...
      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v9
        with:
          version: v2.14

  test:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: Mount a tmpfs for the cross-device move test
        run: |
          sudo mkdir -p /mnt/twin-xdev
          sudo mount -t tmpfs -o size=64m,mode=1777 tmpfs /mnt/twin-xdev
      - name: go test
        shell: bash # Runs with pipefail, so a failing test fails the step despite tee
        env:
          TWIN_XDEV_DIR: /mnt/twin-xdev
        run: go test -race -count=1 -v ./... | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/test.log"
      - name: Check the cross-device move test ran
        run: |
          if ! grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestMoveAcrossRealDevices' "$RUNNER_TEMP/test.log"; then
            echo "::error::TestMoveAcrossRealDevices was skipped: TWIN_XDEV_DIR is not on another filesystem"
            exit 1
          fi
